primary_title: Kindlin-1 and -2 directly bind the C-terminal region of beta integrin cytoplasmic tails and exert integrin-specific activation effects
decision_basis: Kindlin-1 directly binds recombinant beta1-integrin cytoplasmic tails through the membrane-distal NXXY/preceding threonine region
limitations_preserved: Promote direct beta1-tail/kindlin-1 association only; preserve non-phosphorylated tail and integrin-activation context, with no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Kindlin-1 and -2 directly bind the C-terminal region of beta integrin cytoplasmic tails and exert integrin-specific activation effects
decision_basis: Kindlin-2 directly binds recombinant beta1-integrin cytoplasmic tails through the membrane-distal NXXY/preceding threonine region
limitations_preserved: Promote direct beta1-tail/kindlin-2 association only; preserve non-phosphorylated tail and integrin-specific activation boundaries, with no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Tyrosine phosphorylation of integrin beta3 regulates kindlin-2 binding and integrin activation
decision_basis: Kindlin-2 directly binds the non-phosphorylated beta3 NITY759 tail motif, while Tyr759 phosphorylation disrupts binding and coactivation
limitations_preserved: Preserve the non-phosphorylated membrane-distal NITY759 motif and the phosphorylation-sensitive kindlin-2 coactivation boundary; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Kindlin-3 recruitment to the plasma membrane precedes high-affinity beta2-integrin and neutrophil arrest from rolling
decision_basis: Kindlin-3 binds the beta2-integrin cytoplasmic tail at a site distinct from talin-1 and is recruited before high-affinity beta2-integrin activation
limitations_preserved: Promote beta2-tail/kindlin-3 association and bounded inside-out activation timing; preserve the distinct site from talin and neutrophil context, without SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3372743, integrin signalling and function in immune cells review
primary_title: Paxillin binding to a conserved sequence motif in the alpha 4 integrin cytoplasmic domain
decision_basis: The alpha4-integrin cytoplasmic Glu983-Tyr991 motif directly binds paxillin, and E983A/Y991A disrupt the interaction and alpha4-tail migration/spreading effects
limitations_preserved: Promote direct alpha4-tail/paxillin binding at the E983-Y991 motif with bounded migration function; preserve cytoplasmic-tail and cell-context limits, without SCI or terminal-TF inference.
